itens.readme:
# magpie
### Every agent's model. One place.
**Claude Code on Kimi. Codex on DeepSeek. Gemini CLI on GLM. OpenCode on your ChatGPT plan.** 
Switch any of them from the menu bar. One local gateway serves them all, 
and when a quota runs out, it quietly moves on to your next account.
[ ](https://github.com/yetone/magpie-releases/releases/latest) [ ](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/stargazers) [ ](https://discord.gg/vGSnD3ZKQF) [ ](LICENSE) 
Thanks to [Kimi](https://usemagpie.ai/go/kimi/readme) for supporting magpie and the open source community.
 Sponsors 
                       
              
**[Download](https://usemagpie.ai)**  ·  **[Docs](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/start)**  ·  **[Reference](docs/reference.md)**  ·  **[Plugins](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins)**  ·  **[Discord](https://discord.gg/vGSnD3ZKQF)**  ·  **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
## Is magpie for you?
Each agent keeps its model in its own file, in its own format, with its own keys and base URLs. A subscription you pay for works in one agent and nowhere else. magpie puts all of that behind one app and one local gateway:
- **Pick any model for any agent** from one list. magpie edits the one key that matters in the agent's own config.
- **Use one provider everywhere**: an API key, a local model, or the Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini or Grok plan you're signed in to.

itens.readme:
# Agent Autoloop
**让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。**
**中文** | [English](README.en.md)
[上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档)
## 它解决什么问题？
平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。
**Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。
- **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Windows、Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
- **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
- **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。
## 上手
支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。需要 Node 24 或更新、Git，以及一个已经登录的命令行 Agent；macOS/Linux 还需要 curl，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)交给你的 Agent。
Windows PowerShell：
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.ps1 | iex
```
macOS / Linux：
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh
```
安装和 `agent-autoloop update` 都装最新的 [Release](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/releases)，那是通过了全部检查的版本。
装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”：
```bash
agent-autoloop try
```
下面是在终端里的真实输出：
```text
事件发出去了，Agent 开始干活……
Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。
【等你决定】#1 试跑：选一个颜色
这是一次试跑，选哪个都行。
  1. 蓝色
  2. 绿色
回答：agent-autoloop answer 1  
答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。
```
交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近 7 天的轮数、Token 和费用（[统

itens.descricao_en: 244 pixel art effects, every one a small piece of code. Plus a Claude Code skill to make your own.
itens.readme:
# pixelfx.
** 244  pixel art effects and animations, every one a small piece of code.** Fire,
explosions, magic, weather, UI, pickups, critters and more. Play them live, recolor and mirror them, drop them into
a browser game, or export sprite sheets for any engine. Plus a Claude Code skill that makes new ones the way a
picky pixel artist would: draft, render, look, refine.
Every effect that involves a character is **acted out**: he winds up, lets go, freezes on contact and recovers, and a
target takes the hit. Twelve whole moves chain the effects into attacks from wind-up to recovery.
**[open the gallery](https://patch-gg.github.io/pixelfx/)** · [catalog](docs/CATALOG.md) · [acting](#acting) ·
[the skill](#the-skill) · [make your own](#make-your-own) · [publish it on patch](#publish-it-on-patch) ·
[how it works](#how-it-works)
The method is [Hugo Duprez](https://x.com/HugoDuprez)'s, from [How to make (good) pixel art effects with
Claude](https://www.spritefusion.com/blog/how-to-make-good-pixel-art-effects-with-claude): code is clay, trust your
eyes, feed your references. His [open-source effects](https://www.spritefusion.com/pixel-art-vfx) at Sprite Fusion
set the bar, and `src/core/sim.js` and the effects that say so at the top adapt his code. This repo is our take on
the idea at library scale, with a skill to keep going.

itens.descricao_en: Open-source plugin for designing and reviewing software with agents
itens.readme:
Design with an elephant. Review with a goldfish. 
   Install   · 
   Quickstart   · 
   Documentation   · 
   Website 
Develop ideas with context and review documents with fresh eyes. EGM is an open-source plugin for AI assistants.
**Elephant** holds your project context and drafts the specification. **Goldfish** reviewers examine the draft and referenced source material without the earlier conversation, helping expose unstated assumptions and blind spots. **You** make the architectural trade-offs and approve the specification before implementing.
The built-in draft and design-review workflow targets software specifications. For other documents, choose reviewers and standards with `/egm-review-loop`. Bootstrap and drift reporting apply to software codebases.
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/93c799a2-10a3-4266-af02-eb79dd33a9a2
## Install
Choose your coding agent. Install the complete plugin so its skills can read the reviewer prompts and document standards.
### ChatGPT and Codex desktop
Open the [published EGM plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugins_6aeb90f47ec88191a3c107e01d3eb357) in the desktop app and install it. This listing is desktop-only. For Codex CLI, use the commands below.
### Antigravity CLI
```sh
agy plugin install https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model
```
For the **Antigravity App** and **Antigravity for IDEs** (Visual Studio Code extension), run `/plugin` or see the [installation instructions](docs/harnes

itens.readme:
# stack-diagram
[ ](https://github.com/caru-ini/stack-diagram/releases/latest)
[ ](LICENSE)
[ ](https://skills.sh/caru-ini/stack-diagram)
Describe your stack in a sentence. Get an architecture diagram with official logos.
> Diagram our stack: Next.js and a Hono API on Vercel. Postgres on Neon, auth with Clerk, payments with Stripe. GitHub Actions deploys.
```bash
npx skills add caru-ini/stack-diagram
```
Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and [other agents that support skills](https://agentskills.io). In the Claude apps, upload `stack-diagram.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/caru-ini/stack-diagram/releases/latest) as a skill.
## More examples
        Dev tooling, not just clouds  
       Draw our monorepo tooling: a pnpm workspace with Turborepo, Biome, Vitest and Lefthook. GitHub Actions runs CI and publishes to npm. 
        AI apps  
       Draw our docs chatbot: Next.js on Vercel searches Supabase pgvector and answers with Claude. Inngest syncs Notion every night. 
        AWS, with AWS's own icons  
       Draw our app on AWS: CloudFront in front of S3 and an ALB in a public subnet. Fargate, RDS and ElastiCache sit in a private subnet. 
        Google Cloud, with Google's own icons  
       Draw our app on Google Cloud: a global load balancer in front of Cloud Storage and GKE. GKE, Cloud SQL and Memorystore run in one region of a VPC. 
        Azure, with Microsoft's own icons  
       Draw our app on Azure: Front Door in front of Blob Storage and App Service.

itens.descricao_en: Point Claude at any game. Skills, tools and the fal MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game you own: recon, reverse engineering, fal-generated art/3D/audio, in-game testing, showcase videos.
itens.readme:
Skills, tools and a shared knowledge base that let any AI coding agent mod almost any PC game you own.  
  The agent finds the game, works out the engine and the route, reads the real code, builds the mod, makes art, 3D and sound
  with  fal , tests it in the running game, cuts the video, and writes down what it learned for the next agent.
  Coming next: the mod hub at  universalmodder.com .  Publish your mods, remix other people's, and make new ones. 
  Share what you make, get help, and follow along:

Pick your agent. Each gets the same skills (Agent Skills format), the fal MCP server, and the `um` CLI.

|---|---|

| **Codex** | `codex plugin marketplace add rehan-remade/universal-modder` `codex plugin add universal-modder@universal-modder` |
| **Gemini CLI** | `gemini extensions install https://github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder` |
| **VS Code / Copilot** | Enable `chat.plugins.enabled`, run **Chat: Install Plugin From Source**, and enter this repo's URL |
